attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole notice is one sentence — «Οι Άγιοι Έξι Οσιομάρτυρες οι ερημίτες μαρτύρησαν δια ξίφους, μαζί με τον Άγιο Ούαρο (βλέπε την ίδια ημέρα)» — and it names nobody of the six, so this is one entry and one folder, on `BRIEF.md` §4's test. Their story is on the page of `varus-the-martyr`, who is an upgrade on this same day: six venerable ascetics brought into the prison he guarded, a seventh who had died on the road of old age, Varus answering «ἰδοὺ ἐγώ» when the judge asked after the seventh, and the six beheaded the day after Varus died under torture. **No `dates`**: neither page gives the six a year, and the reign named on his, «επί Διοκλητιανού», is a reign and not a date. No `locations` and no hymn on their own page. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
